scope: Proposition 5.2 (Duality and branching in the outer sum) of the manuscript “Midpoint convexity from bounded tree potentials and path costs” (preprints/Midpoint-convexity-from-bounded-tree-potentials-and-path-costs-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 331 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 965c8f078bcaef03), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The space X is reflexive, has separable dual, and its dual is the Hilbert sum of the spaces (Hn, pn), with pairing f(x) = X n ⟨fn, xn⟩, ∥f∥2 ∗ = X n pn(fn)2 . Every coordinate vector en,s and every root path bn,s has norm one. For fixed n and |s| < n, the children (en,s⌢j)j≥1 are weakly null. If α∥ · ∥ ≤ N ≤ β∥ · ∥, with 0 < α ≤ β, then δN (t) = 0 for every 0 < t ≤ α/β. In particular no equivalent norm on X is asymptotically uniformly convex.
